title: SR-26 Transmission Days Kept on an Owner Auto Policy Cancelled at the Insured's Request
content:
**Rule.** When an Owner Auto Policy term is cancelled at the insured's request, SR-26 transmission days are kept when a certificate backed by the term, a filing under the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), stood filed on the cancellation effective date.

**Standing on the cancellation effective date.** Every certificate backed by the term is read as it stood on the cancellation effective date, so an SR-26 transmitted after that date does not change the reading. A certificate stood filed on that date when either holds:
- the certificate entered first with status filed has its filed date on or before that date; or
- the certificate entered first with status cancellation filed has its filed date on or before that date and its SR-26 date after it.

The company stays bound to the state until the certificate's run-off days after the SR-26, which goes out no earlier than the ending date and no later than the certificate's SR-26 transmission period after it (the ending date counted as day 0). So the calendar days from the cancellation effective date to the processing date, at most that transmission period, are also kept, and they are taken off the days returned, never below zero. The transmission period is the certificate's figure, as the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) schedule sets it.

| Processing date, against the cancellation effective date | Days kept |
|---|---|
| Processed on or before the cancellation effective date | none |
| Processed one or more days after it, but fewer days than the transmission period | the days elapsed |
| Processed on or after the day the transmission period ends | the full transmission period |
| No backing certificate standing filed on the cancellation effective date | none |

**Questions the rule answers.**
- *A certificate whose SR-26 is dated before the cancellation effective date?* It did not stand filed on that date, so no days are kept.
- *A certificate whose SR-26 is dated after the cancellation effective date?* It still stood filed on that date, so days are kept as in the table.
- *Hypothetically, with a 3-day transmission period, how many days are kept when the cancellation is processed 2 days after the cancellation effective date?* 2 days; processed 5 days after it, 3 days.
- *Can the days kept make the days returned negative?* No; the days returned never fall below zero.
- *What is kept when the cancellation is processed on or before the cancellation effective date?* Nothing.
